cases.name: diagnostics-sync
cases.description: snapshots one synchronous diagnostic before original and returned graphs mutate

cases.name: diagnostics-async
cases.description: snapshots one asynchronous diagnostic before original and returned graphs mutate

cases.name: diagnostics-rich
cases.description: snapshots nested objects, arrays, and fallback-cloned values on the diagnostic graph

cases.name: diagnostics-fallback
cases.description: snapshots function and non-plain prototype values on the diagnostic graph

cases.name: diagnostics-structured-clone
cases.description: snapshots cloneable class instances on the diagnostic graph

cases.name: diagnostics-null-prototype
cases.description: snapshots null-prototype diagnostic records on the diagnostic graph

cases.name: invoke-sync-success
cases.description: executes a synchronous hook immediately and discards its returned value

cases.name: invoke-async-success
cases.description: returns undefined for an asynchronous callback and guards its completion internally

cases.name: invoke-sync-throw
cases.description: rejects with a HookInvocationError when the hook throws synchronously

cases.name: invoke-async-reject
cases.description: returns undefined and routes an asynchronous rejection with its exact cause

cases.name: invoke-swallow-sync
cases.description: completes synchronously when onHookError swallows a synchronous failure

cases.name: invoke-swallow-async
cases.description: returns undefined while onHookError asynchronously swallows a failure

cases.name: invoke-unexpected-async
cases.description: routes a rejection from an unexpectedly-async hook to onHookError without producing an unhandled rejection

cases.name: invokeasync-sync-success
cases.description: executes a synchronous hook immediately and resolves its completion promise

cases.name: invokeasync-async-success
cases.description: waits for a statically asynchronous hook to complete

cases.name: invokeasync-sync-throw
cases.description: rejects with HookInvocationError when a hook throws synchronously

cases.name: invokeasync-async-throw
cases.description: rejects with HookInvocationError when a hook rejects asynchronously

cases.name: invokeasync-timeout
cases.description: routes a timeout through the same HookInvocationError contract

cases.name: invokeasync-thenable
cases.description: waits for a runtime thenable returned by a hook statically typed as void

cases.name: invokeasync-function-thenable
cases.description: treats function values with a then method as thenables

cases.name: onhookerror-sync-throw
cases.description: propagates a synchronous throw from onHookError directly

cases.name: onhookerror-async-reject-invoke
cases.description: invoke internally observes an async-rejecting onHookError result without producing an unhandled rejection

cases.name: onhookerror-async-reject-invokeasync
cases.description: invokeAsync propagates an async-rejecting onHookError result as its terminal failure

cases.name: onhookerror-loop-guard
cases.description: does not loop forever when onHookError is deterministically broken

cases.name: options-no-options
cases.description: accepts no options

cases.name: options-malformed
cases.description: throws ValidationError for a malformed options object

cases.name: options-non-positive
cases.description: throws ValidationError for a non-positive timeoutMs

cases.name: detectreentrancy-no-throw
cases.description: does not throw for non-reentrant calls when enabled

cases.name: detectreentrancy-wrapped
cases.description: throws ReentrantHookInvocationError wrapped by HookInvocationError when nested inside another invoke

cases.name: detectreentrancy-direct
cases.description: propagates ReentrantHookInvocationError directly when not nested inside onHookError handling

cases.name: detectreentrancy-disabled
cases.description: does not flag reentrancy when disabled

cases.name: timeout-invokeasync-fast
cases.description: invokeAsync resolves normally when the hook settles before the timeout

cases.name: timeout-invoke-fire-and-forget
cases.description: invoke returns undefined while routing a fire-and-forget timeout without an unhandled rejection

cases.name: timeout-no-dangling-timer
cases.description: does not leave a dangling timer once the hook settles before the timeout

cases.name: timeout-sync-never-applies
cases.description: never applies a timeout to a genuinely synchronous hook result
